text:
maria: kicking off a synthetic saturation soak in staging now — target ~5k rps for 15m to validate per-org and per-key burst behavior. will tweak traffic mix during run.
kevin: quick question — which quota rules are live in this env? thought we had per-org 120qps and per-key base 8qps with burst? also are token limits enforced for embedding calls?
sanjay: correct: staging mirrors prod RL rules but reserved capacity is reduced. per-org=120 qps, per-key base=8 qps, burst_window=2s currently. note: older nodes have known bucket regen lag.
elaine: can we add token_bucket metrics to the staging console? current panels only show rejects and throttle_429 which isn't enough to debug root cause.
maria: yes — i'll add temporary graphs: token_bucket_available, refill_rate, last_refill_ts, plus per-route split (gen vs embed). elaine — will that cover what you need?
elaine: that plus per-route breakdown is ideal. embeddings tend to drain faster.
tyler: test harness request: simulate 1 org with many keys and skewed hot keys. want to observe hot-key isolation and fallback behavior.
maria: short test config pasted:
```
clients: 200
hot_keys: 5
rps_per_client: 0.25
duration_s: 900
payload_mix: {gen:0.7, embed:0.3}
```
kevin: will routing policies be respected? need low-tier keys routed to small model variants to exercise fallbacks.
sanjay: yes. routing policy active: low-tier -> model-v1-small as fallback under pressure. enabling circuit-breaker logs and fallback_count spikes.
maria: starting run now. tagging ops-bot to capture infra events.
ops-bot: [alert] staging-kluster-3 CPU spike at 1755554402; node-autoscale added +2 nodes :rocket: 
kevin: seeing initial throughput ~4200 rps. rejects ~1.5%, mostly from hot keys. per-key 429s indicate expected backpressure.
elaine: console update: token_bucket_available shows hot keys deplete quickly. refill_rate currently 4 tokens/s per key. can we reduce burst_window to 1s next iteration?
maria: yes will clamp to 1s for next run. switching config after warmup.
tyler: telemetry ask: record route_id + key_hash_prefix (first 6 chars) when fallback happens, so we can correlate without exposing full keys. privacy preserved.
devex-bot: artifacts uploaded to staging-test-runs/1755554321 — https://internal.redwood/ci/runs/1755554321
sanjay: log review: many 503s from model-v1-small when fallback pool is warming. suggests fallback pool needs faster warmup or standing capacity.
kevin: proposed follow-ups: 1) clamp burst window to 1s, 2) pre-warm fallback pool before traffic spike, 3) add bucket_refill_alert to console for sustained depletion (pager to SRE).
maria: notes: per-org throttles only tripped after sustained >115 qps for 30s, which matches policy. per-key limits triggered earlier for hot keys. saving artifacts and will open backlog tickets in eng-platform.
elaine: thanks — please post a short thread summary in #eng-platform with the artifacts link.
maria: done. final run ended 1755554980. summary in artifacts. follow-ups: pre-warm fallback pool, add refill graphs, clamp burst_window. :white_check_mark:
